title: Alpha Lab operator-lineage + extraction-risk + adversarial-alpha + execution-toxicity shadow enrichment
objective: Implement the minimum deterministic SHADOW-ONLY enrichment needed to attach role-aware operator lineage, extraction risk evidence, realizable alpha-window evidence and execution-toxicity evidence to existing exact-CA Alpha Lab rows. Reuse existing Moonshot/Pons discovery, wallet ledger, lifecycle, Blockscout and outcome owners. Do not create a parallel scanner, score, scheduler, trading engine or automatic execution path.
required_behavior: Add a bounded operator-lineage enrichment invoked only after exact CA / launch identity exists. It must not discover the chain independently.
Represent addresses, contracts, launches, collectors and protocol infrastructure as typed nodes and timestamped evidence edges.
Require protocol_shared_flag on every edge touching known shared infrastructure and exclude infrastructure-only paths from operator identity.
Persist external label seeds as EXTERNAL_LEAD or POINT_IN_TIME_ONLY until independently reproduced.
Support rotating-key supersession / expiry without deleting historical observations.
Produce independent shadow fields for operator_extraction_risk_state, realizable_adversarial_alpha_state and execution_toxicity_state. Never collapse them into one score.
Operator risk must be explainable through evidence refs, not an opaque model weight.
Alpha-window evidence must exclude operator-linked wallets from independent buyer breadth and must require sellability/liquidity/slippage evidence.
Execution toxicity is negative-only: it may downgrade/close a window but may never create a positive-alpha state.
Preserve first-public-executable timestamp and point-in-time snapshots at configured offsets where data exists.
Attach outcomes only through existing lifecycle/outcome owner; no ATH-only alpha credit.
Keep Wazz/Atarashi/Outputlayer claims source-attributed and separate from reproduced chain facts.
Emit UNKNOWN rather than zero on missing graph, market, route or MEV evidence.
No user-facing BUY/SELL/ENTRY_CANDIDATE output from this implementation.
first_regressions: Pons factory / launcher infrastructure shared across unrelated launches must not create an operator link.
Uniswap Universal Router 0x8876789976decbfcbbbe364623c63652db8c0904 must be typed PROTOCOL_INFRASTRUCTURE and cannot identify Outputlayer Operator 2 alone.
Operator-1 receiving contract 0x68a04a63fd1d8eabf167ef48ed0a0ef06c2374d9 must reproduce CREATED_CONTRACT edge from 0x44c0ba0b734d4b7705fcd07ddae9fbbc078d74dd when fixture evidence is supplied.
CRUMBS/DRAFT/DEED same Pons contract creator must not be interpreted as common scam operator.
A stale rotating-key label may remain historical but cannot stay active without refreshed evidence.
High extraction-risk and SHADOW_WINDOW_CANDIDATE may coexist if independent demand/sellability evidence supports it.
HIGH/BLOCKING execution toxicity closes/downgrades the alpha window without changing operator-risk state.
Missing MEV evidence remains UNKNOWN, not NORMAL.
Wallet quality learned after signal time cannot be backfilled into the signal snapshot.

prospective_test.champion: existing Alpha Lab / Moonshot + current wallet/deployer and sellability evidence
prospective_test.challenger: champion + operator-lineage + execution-toxicity + dual-axis shadow fields
